name: MSP Mesh
area: Twin Cities, Greater Minnesota and western Wisconsin
notes: The settings page says to leave the primary channel as it is and does not give a frequency slot; leave the slot on automatic.
Hops for portable nodes: 3 to 5 inside the 494/694 metro loop and nearby suburbs; try 6 or 7 only if messages don't travel far enough.
Stationary outdoor nodes: role CLIENT or CLIENT_BASE; 1 or 2 hops at most if the node is an unattended relay.
Portable nodes: telemetry off. Intervals are minimums ('or more').
Their page is marked current as of November 2026.
